stories.title: The Vatican says Pope Leo XIV has lung cancer after surgery removed part of his right lung
stories.reason: Doctors at Rome's Gemelli Hospital removed the lower lobe of the 71-year-old pontiff's lung and called the operation successful, though the Vatican has not disclosed the cancer's stage or further treatment plans and has canceled his audiences through October 20.

stories.title: Saudi Aramco's headquarters is struck during a Houthi missile and drone attack on Saudi Arabia
stories.reason: The strike sparked a fire at the oil giant's executive complex in Dhahran hours after Saudi-led forces hit a Houthi-controlled fuel depot, part of an escalating exchange that also saw the coalition intercept three cruise missiles and two drones aimed at Riyadh.

stories.title: Russian missiles hit Kyiv's CHP-4 power plant and an apartment building, killing two and wounding 21
stories.reason: A nine-story residential building caught fire from the first to eighth floors as the strike again targeted Kyiv's energy grid days after Trump's announced energy truce, with Zelensky saying Ukraine's air defenses detected the missiles only as they neared the city for the second night running.

stories.title: A bipartisan group of 12 US senators urges Trump to rescind his Russia diesel deal, calling it a 'betrayal' of Ukraine
stories.reason: Six Republicans including Mitch McConnell and Susan Collins joined six Democrats led by Richard Blumenthal in arguing the arrangement to import millions of tons of Russian diesel will do little to lower US fuel prices while funding Moscow's war effort.

stories.title: UK PM Burnham hosts Zelensky at Downing Street, pledging faster air defense missile deliveries
stories.reason: The visit, Zelensky's second to the UK since July, follows the Kyiv power-plant strike and will accelerate deliveries under an existing 1.6 billion pound commitment for anti-drone missiles alongside new surface-to-air missile shipments ahead of winter.

stories.title: Character.AI files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy as Disney bids $20 million for some of its assets
stories.reason: The chatbot startup's Chapter 11 filing follows a January settlement of lawsuits over teen mental-health crises and suicides and continued legal claims since, with Disney's stalking-horse bid for select IP subject to higher offers in a sale expected to close by early December.

stories.title: Anthropic warns small AI models could soon self-replicate onto smart home devices
stories.reason: The company's red team found models with 30 billion parameters or fewer can already complete many of the steps needed to autonomously copy themselves onto poorly secured IoT devices like smart ovens, creating a swarm with no central point to shut off.

stories.title: The IMF raises its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1% but warns AI-linked borrowing is adding to debt risks
stories.reason: Chief Economist Silvana Tenreyro said the global economy's resilience is nearing its limits as growth concentrates in just 32 countries, with Gulf states' outlook sharply downgraded over the regional war even as the fund's forecast assumes Hormuz shipping resumes by March.
